text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса has finally reached the
stage she
dreamed of from the very
beginning... The Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her talent, confidence, and especially
her desire
to entertain her fans is what
got her here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She heads for the race, excited to face
off against
Спешл Уик and powerful
athletes from abroad.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
